requirements.summary: Hosted first; growth remains optional: One hosted modular management API, separate redirect for public availability, one worker and relational authority. Cache and visit channel isolate derived work. Analytics stays relational initially; analytical storage/private delivery require a future justified decision.
requirements.remainingWork: Required acceptance expectation; no runtime or verification is supplied. Original decision status remains in the pinned factory; this new record tracks outstanding implementation/review only.

requirements.summary: Production workload, SLO and recovery remain open: Production traffic, SLO, RPO/RTO, analytics freshness and commercial retention are unspecified. Values in binding policies are illustrative examples only. Recovery owner: operations; product owner approves loss and retention. Restore authority first, invalidate caches, replay retained durable work and reconcile billing with provider.
requirements.remainingWork: Owner: product owner with operations lead. Blocks production implementation sizing and recovery approval; design exploration can continue. Original decision status remains in the pinned factory; this new record tracks outstanding implementation/review only.

requirements.summary: Tenant access and revocation: Check principal, tenant and current membership/API-key state on every API, database operation, job start and export download. Revocation takes effect on the next authorization check; cancel queued jobs and deny old downloads. Public lookup discloses no tenant-private data.
requirements.remainingWork: Required acceptance expectation; no runtime or verification is supplied. Original decision status remains in the pinned factory; this new record tracks outstanding implementation/review only.

requirements.summary: Stable printed identity and versioned content: Printed short URL and paths remain stable across link, artwork and hosted content versions. Encoded payload is separate; changing a static printed payload requires reprint. Lookup mutations use monotonic revisions and propagate within illustrative 15 seconds, including disable; failed propagation retries from authority. Never acknowledge a domain mutation before authoritative commit.
requirements.remainingWork: Required acceptance expectation; no runtime or verification is supplied. Original decision status remains in the pinned factory; this new record tracks outstanding implementation/review only.

requirements.summary: Analytics meaning, retention and recovery: A visit is an accepted public resolution attempt, not a unique human or a confirmed destination page view. Deduplicate retained event IDs; label gaps and freshness. Illustrative event/aggregate retention: 90 days; exports: 7 days. Delete or anonymize tenant data and objects, invalidate downloads; restored data reapplies deletion tombstones before access. Authorized staff security audit retains redacted actions for illustrative 365 days.
requirements.remainingWork: Required acceptance expectation; no runtime or verification is supplied. Original decision status remains in the pinned factory; this new record tracks outstanding implementation/review only.

requirements.summary: Redirect availability with bounded analytics degradation: Cache miss/unavailability falls back to authority. Source failure fails closed; disabled links return unavailable. Visit publication has no synchronous persisted-ack prerequisite: illustrative 25 ms attempt and 60-second loss window; beyond that window circuit-break visits until channel recovery, expose analytics gaps. Browser receives Location and follows it; service never fetches the destination. Recovery does not invent lost visits.
requirements.remainingWork: Required acceptance expectation; no runtime or verification is supplied. Original decision status remains in the pinned factory; this new record tracks outstanding implementation/review only.

requirements.summary: Duplicate callbacks and printed links on downgrade: Verify signature, persist provider eventId plus tenantId and acknowledge duplicates without repeating effects. Entitlements owns effective plan state; reconcile out-of-order callbacks with provider version. Downgrade blocks new paid features/exports but preserves existing safe printed links and hosted content; abuse and domain ownership revocation override this grace.
requirements.remainingWork: Required acceptance expectation; no runtime or verification is supplied. Original decision status remains in the pinned factory; this new record tracks outstanding implementation/review only.

requirements.summary: Domain, TLS and abuse enforcement: Application owns attach/transfer/removal and path identity. DNS provider validates fresh challenge, operates TLS issuance/renewal and certificate removal. Transfer first revokes old tenant routing; no new routing until ownership and TLS are valid. Removal fails closed; provider failure retains pending state. Abuse shutdown updates authority and invalidates cached destinations within illustrative 15 seconds, with audit and monitored overdue enforcement.
requirements.remainingWork: Required acceptance expectation; no runtime or verification is supplied. Original decision status remains in the pinned factory; this new record tracks outstanding implementation/review only.
